title: Normalized run event
description: One line of events.jsonl. The uniform, harness-agnostic event schema (FR-004..008). Produced by each harness image from its native stream; redacted by the orchestrator before write. One JSON object per line; faithful order; content never summarized.

kind.description: The event kind. Same seven kinds across every harness (FR-004).

turn.description: Turn number the event belongs to (FR-005).

tokens_in.description: Input tokens for this event where the harness reports them; null = not reported, distinct from a real 0 (FR-005).

tokens_out.description: Output tokens where reported; null = not reported (FR-005).

cost_usd.description: Cost where the harness reports it (api/pi); null for subscription harnesses or when not reported (FR-005).

text.description: Message text for system/user/assistant/final, or the error message for error.

args.description: tool_call only: the tool arguments as sent (FR-006).

diff.description: tool_result only, file edits: the change as a unified diff, rendered as a diff by the viewer (FR-006/FR-020).

missing.description: tool_result only: true when the harness cannot produce a faithful result — recorded as missing rather than reconstructed (FR-008/FR-021).
